label: Reading the failure
subgoals: Extract the failure type, time and node from the log
Map the failure to its likely cause
Treat partial continuation results as failures

label: Proposing the smallest fix
subgoals: Prefer initial guesses and realistic stimuli over tolerance changes
Reject fixes that alter the circuit being solved
Feed each rerun's failure back into the next proposal

label: Proving the fix did not change the answer
section: Proving the fix did not change the answer
subgoals: Compare key results with golden values after every fix
Rerun at tighter tolerances to separate numerical from physical effects
Reward agreement with golden results rather than mere completion
